concepts.name: Do-not-sac-initiator-without-net-gain
concepts.trigger: A forcing capture/check is made by a higher-value piece and that piece is immediately recapturable by equal or lower-value enemy piece with no follow-up material win
concepts.value_adjustment: Strongly decrease move value; apply larger penalty when the initiating piece value is >= bishop/rook
concepts.why: Multiple forcing moves won tempo but immediately lost the attacker, producing repeated material swings against the mover

concepts.name: Penalty-for-hanging-checking-piece
concepts.trigger: A checking move places the checking piece on a square capturable by the king or simple recapture, without mating net or major gain
concepts.value_adjustment: Decrease move value; increase penalty if the checking piece is bishop/rook and capture is by king with low tactical risk
concepts.why: Checks looked forcing but were neutralized by immediate king recapture, causing direct material loss

concepts.name: Recapture-risk-filter-on-forcing-moves
concepts.trigger: Candidate move is forcing (capture/check/threat) but lands on a square attacked by multiple enemy units and defended weakly
concepts.value_adjustment: Apply pre-move safety tax proportional to (enemy_attackers - friendly_defenders) and attacker piece value
concepts.why: Repeated early forcing moves created immediate recapture opportunities and consistent ~300cp losses

concepts.name: Preserve-large-advantage-by-trade-safety
concepts.trigger: Side has large material edge and can choose between sharp forcing line vs simplification/secure defense
concepts.value_adjustment: Increase value of safe exchanges and king-safety consolidation; decrease speculative tactics that reopen counterplay
concepts.why: A position with very large edge still ended drawn, indicating conversion failures from unnecessary complexity

concepts.name: King-capture-alert-priority
concepts.trigger: After opponent sacrifice/entry, legal king capture exists that wins material and does not expose immediate tactical collapse
concepts.value_adjustment: Increase priority of evaluating legal king recaptures before quieter alternatives
concepts.why: Evidence shows missed or delayed king captures around forcing exchanges; fast recognition improves material retention

concepts.name: Post-castle-tactical-blunder-check
concepts.trigger: King-safety move (e.g., castling) is considered while loose material/tactical captures are available to opponent
concepts.value_adjustment: Before rewarding king safety, subtract value if opponent has immediate high-confidence material win next move
concepts.why: A nominally good king-safety move was followed by immediate material loss, implying tactical scan must gate strategic bonuses

concepts.name: Low-clock-decision-simplification
concepts.trigger: Clock pressure with multiple tactical candidates of similar static score
concepts.value_adjustment: Prefer low-branching, materially safe continuations; reduce value of complex forcing sacs requiring long verification
concepts.why: Pattern of forcing but unsafe captures suggests over-optimistic tactical choices; simplifying under time should reduce blunders

policy: Generic self-play concepts and current-position feature tools only; no exact FEN move answers or external engine labels.
